full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio portrait frames a young woman from just below the shoulders upward against a nearly plain pale background. She faces the camera squarely with large dark eyes and an unwavering, unsmiling gaze. Short dark hair lies close to the head, with a few fine strands crossing her forehead and the hairline cropped close to the top of the frame. Heavy dark eye makeup draws strong rings around the eyes, making them the sharpest points in the image. Her face is pale and smooth, but one side falls into a soft gray shadow that models the nose, cheek, and jaw. Her lips are relaxed and closed, forming a quieter center below the intense eyes. Two pale roses flank the face at shoulder height: one on the left is large and open, with ragged petal edges, while the one at right is tighter and sits on a long visible stem. A dark scarf or high collar with curved and striped pattern wraps beneath the chin, and a dark garment fills the lower corners. One hand enters the lower center, lightly gripping fabric or stems near the throat. The flowers are bright enough to echo the face but retain gray detail in their layered petals. The background has no scenic setting, allowing the triangular placement of eyes, flowers, and hand to dominate. Strong tonal contrast separates black hair and clothing from pale skin and blossoms, while modest grain and visible midtones avoid a glossy digital finish. The portrait feels confrontational yet composed, its decorative flowers softening rather than distracting from the direct expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白影棚肖像从肩部稍下方往上拍摄一位年轻女子，背后是近乎平坦的浅色背景。她正面面对相机，以一双大而深的眼睛坚定地看向镜头，没有笑容。短深发贴近头形，几根细发落过额头，发顶几乎被画幅上缘截住。浓重的深色眼妆在双眼周围形成强环，使眼睛成为图中最锐利的重点。脸部苍白平滑，但一侧落入柔和灰影，塑造鼻、颊与下颌。双唇放松闭合，在强烈目光下成为较安静的中心。两朵浅色玫瑰在肩高处夹住脸：左边一朵较大、较开，花瓣边缘参差；右边一朵更紧，长花茎清楚可见。带曲线与条纹的深色围巾或高领裹在下颌下方，深色衣服填满下角。一只手从下方中央伸入，在喉前轻握布料或花茎。花朵足够明亮，与脸相呼应，层层花瓣仍保留灰色细节。背景不交代风景，使双眼、花与手形成的三角排列占据主导。强反差把黑发和衣物从浅色皮肤、花朵中分开，而适度颗粒和可见中间灰避免数字式光滑。肖像直接而沉着，装饰性的花柔化、却不转移对正面神情的注意。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast black-and-white fashion photography with frontal close framing, clear eye contact, and a simple pale ground. Build visual force from a few decisive dark areas around the eyes, hair, and clothing, set against luminous skin and softly textured light objects. Directional light can shade one side of the face without obscuring its expression. Use small accessories or organic forms to frame rather than compete with the central features. The crop is tight, often pressing against the hairline and shoulders, while a hand or partial detail at the lower edge completes the shape. Keep fine grain and visible gray petal, fabric, or skin texture inside the bold contrast. The mood is cool, graphic, direct, and composed, with ornamental softness held in tension against an unyielding gaze.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差黑白时尚摄影采用正面近距裁切、清晰目光交流和简明浅背景。视觉力量来自眼周、头发与衣物几块决定性的深色，对照发亮皮肤和有柔软肌理的浅色物件。定向光可以压暗脸的一侧，却不遮住神情。少量饰件或有机形体用于框住中心五官，而非与之竞争。画幅裁切紧，常贴近发际和肩线，下缘的手或局部细节则完成形状。在大胆明暗里保留细颗粒与花瓣、织物或皮肤的可见灰调肌理。气质冷静、图形化、直接而自持，让装饰柔软与毫不退让的目光保持张力。
theme_en: A high-contrast black-and-white close portrait of a short-haired woman holding pale roses beside her face
theme_zh: 一幅高反差黑白近景肖像中，短发女子把浅色玫瑰举在脸旁
name: David Bailey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
